title: Kelvin–Helmholtz billows
alt: Two horizontal shear layers rolled up into rows of spiral vortices on a black background: the upper row in red (negative vorticity), the lower row in green (positive vorticity), thin filaments wrapping around each core.
caption: Vorticity of two tanh shear layers (half-thickness δ = 0.08, Re = Uδ/ν = 400) at t = 7.0, nonlinear IVP seeded with the box mode closest to the most unstable one (αδ = 0.503; maximum at 0.445); 384 × 192 RealFourier modes (3/2 dealiasing), streamfunction form, RK443, dt = 0.0025, 4 CPU cores.

validated.value: ω_i max = 0.189702 at α = 0.44492 (inviscid tanh layer, L = 20, N = 384)

field: Vorticity ω = −∇²ψ (the component normal to the plane) of two rolled-up shear layers at t = 7.
colour: Colour: ω, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive; the scale ends at the 99.7th percentile of |ω| (larger values saturate).

title: Kelvin–Helmholtz dye
alt: A pale horizontal band of passive dye between two shear layers, its edges curled into rows of spirals that entrain dark fluid, outlined by one thin fluorescent yellow-green line at half concentration.
caption: Passive dye marking the central band (Schmidt number 1) in the same Kelvin–Helmholtz run at t = 7.0; the line is the iso-concentration c = 1/2. 384 × 192 RealFourier modes (3/2 dealiasing), RK443, dt = 0.0025.

validated.value: ω_i max = 0.189702 at α = 0.44492 (inviscid tanh layer, L = 20, N = 384)

field: Concentration c of a passive dye that starts as the central band, at t = 7; the yellow-green line is c = 1/2.

title: Rayleigh–Bénard convection
alt: A long horizontal slab of convecting fluid on black: bright hot plumes rise from the bottom wall and dark cold plumes sink from the top, carried by large convection rolls across a nearly uniform grey interior.
caption: Temperature in 2D Rayleigh–Bénard convection at Ra = 1e6, Pr = 1, aspect ratio 4, rigid walls, t = 0.0600 thermal times (≈ 60 free-fall times); 384 × 96 RealFourier × Chebyshev, 3/2 dealiasing, RK443, dt = 1e-05, 4 CPU cores.

validated.value: Nu = 4.99432 at Ra = 1e5 (2D, Lx = 2, RK443), agreement with Dedalus to 1e-8
validated.reference: Dedalus (Burns et al. 2020, Phys. Rev. Research 2, 023068), same equations

field: Temperature T (the full temperature, conduction profile included) of 2D convection at Ra = 10⁶.
colour: Colour: T, from −A (black) to +A (light grey), with A the 99th percentile of |T| in the interior |z| < 0.4; the boundary layers, which reach ±1/2, saturate.

title: Kuramoto–Sivashinsky chaos, L = 22
alt: Space-time diagram of a chaotic Kuramoto–Sivashinsky solution: time runs left to right, space vertically; wavy red and green stripes of negative and positive u merge, split and drift, separated by black zero lines.
caption: u(x, t) of u_t + u u_x + u_xx + u_xxxx = 0 on a periodic domain L = 22, over 250 time units after a transient of 300. RealFourier N = 32 (dealias 3/2), RK443, dt = 0.01.

validated.value: travelling wave TW2 seeded from a live L = 22 run: c = −0.349541, E = 0.604820, Newton residual 4.9e-16
validated.reference: Cvitanović, Davidchack & Siminos 2010, SIAM J. Appl. Dyn. Syst. 9, 1–33 (velocity 0.34954, energy 0.6048)

field: The solution u(x, t) of the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equation, L = 22: x upwards, t to the right.
colour: Colour: u, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive; the scale ends at the 99.7th percentile of |u|.

title: Taylor–Couette: the first Taylor vortices
alt: A horizontal band of alternating red and green vertical stripes fading to black at the top and bottom walls: the azimuthal velocity of Taylor vortices between two cylinders, with thin silver closed streamlines circling the dark vortex centres.
caption: Critical axisymmetric mode of circular Couette flow, radius ratio η = 0.5, outer cylinder at rest: azimuthal velocity and meridional streamlines over two wavelengths at Re_c = 68.1863, k = 3.1625. Fourier × Chebyshev AnnulusBasis N = 24, dense QZ, Brent on the growth rate.

validated.reference: Recktenwald, Lücke & Müller 1993, Phys. Rev. E 48, 4444, Table I (68.19, 3.16)

field: Azimuthal velocity u_φ of the critical axisymmetric mode in the meridional (z, r) plane, with streamlines of the meridional flow (u_r, u_z).
colour: Colour: u_φ normalised to a largest magnitude of 1, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive.

title: Swift–Hohenberg labyrinth
alt: A dense labyrinth of light and dark parallel stripes of fixed width, curving in patches of different orientations that meet at defects and grain boundaries.
caption: Rolls of du/dt = r u − (1 + ∇²)² u − u³ at r = 0.1 grown from noise in a periodic box of 24 × 12 roll wavelengths, t = 600. RealFourier × RealFourier 192 × 96 (dealias 2 for the cubic term), SBDF2, dt = 0.5.

validated.value: roll amplitude A(r = 0.1) = 0.3652433015 (N-converged, Newton residual 8e-14); (A² − 4r/3)/r² → 1/144 along the continued branch; 2D IVP on the branch to 1e-9
validated.reference: Swift & Hohenberg 1977, Phys. Rev. A 15, 319; Cross & Hohenberg 1993, Rev. Mod. Phys. 65, 851

field: The field u(x, y) of the Swift–Hohenberg equation at r = 0.1, t = 600.
colour: Colour: u, from −max |u| (black, troughs) to +max |u| (light grey, crests).

title: Rossby–Haurwitz wave on the sphere
alt: A globe seen from mid-northern latitudes on a black background, covered by large alternating green and red vorticity lobes: four around each hemisphere, the northern and southern lobes of opposite sign across the equator, with faint concentric ripples near the pole.
caption: Relative vorticity of the wavenumber-4 Rossby–Haurwitz wave after 14 days (Williamson et al. 1992, test case 6), inviscid shallow water on the rotating sphere, seen from 35° N (no hyperdiffusion damps the faint small-scale ripples). Fourier × spin-weighted spherical harmonics, T63 (128 × 64), implicit Coriolis, RK443, dt = 0.03/Ω.

validated.value: 14 days: mass exact, energy conserved to 1.4e-7; pattern 7.7% slower than the non-divergent Haurwitz speed, converged (T42/T63 within 0.13%)
validated.reference: Williamson et al. 1992, J. Comput. Phys. 102, 211–224, test case 6; Haurwitz 1940

field: Relative vorticity ζ (the radial component of the curl of the velocity) of the shallow-water flow after 14 days.
colour: Colour: ζ, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive, scaled to the largest |ζ|.

title: Tollmien–Schlichting wave in a channel
alt: A wide band of red and green lobes on black: the streamwise velocity of the least stable wave of plane channel flow, strongest in bright layers just inside the top and bottom walls, the upper and lower halves of opposite sign, with a sharp phase kink near each wall.
caption: Streamwise velocity perturbation of the Orr–Sommerfeld mode of plane Poiseuille flow at Re = 10000, α = 1, one wavelength: c = 0.23752649 + 0.00373967i. Chebyshev N = 64, dense QZ, tau modes removed by an N = 96 drift test.
field: Streamwise velocity perturbation u = Re(û(y) exp(iαx)) of the least stable Orr–Sommerfeld mode, over one wavelength.
colour: Colour: u normalised to a largest |û| of 1, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive.
